headline: OpenAI launches verified Business Agents and profiles in ChatGPT
summary: OpenAI launched verified 'Business Agents' letting ChatGPT users interact directly with brands for tasks like comparison shopping, part of new business-profile features rolling out in beta to eligible US e-commerce businesses.

claims.statement: OpenAI introduced verified Business Agents and new business profile features in ChatGPT.

sources.quote: ChatGPT is getting verified AI ‘Business Agents’
ChatGPT is going to let you chat with verified "Business Agents" that represent a brand to help you with things like comparison shopping.
OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google
OpenAI is looking to make ChatGPT a more robust consumer discovery engine, and a host of new features seek to empower businesses to help it do that.

claims.statement: The feature launches first in beta to eligible US e-commerce and online service businesses.

sources.quote: The feature, available first to "eligible" e-commerce and online service businesses in the US, is launching as part of a suite of business-focused features in ChatGPT being announced today in beta.
